title: lagenophora pumila
intro: Lagenophora pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Bush Daisy or New Zealand Daisy, is a flowering plant native to the southern parts of New Zealand. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Lagenophora pumila are attributed to its ability to exhibit bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, sesquiterpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which may have antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular-protective effects. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Lagenophora pumila as a medicinal plant.
